department: Neuroscience and Neurotechnology PhD (interdisciplinary; Biological Sciences is the default home school)

deadline.value: The Georgia Tech portal lists 1 December 2026 for Fall 2027 entry through Biological Sciences (the same date for the other home schools listed).
deadline.quote: Neuroscience & Neurotechnology (Biological Sciences) Biological Sciences Sciences Atlanta Doctoral Fall 2026 Fall 2027 12/01/2025 12/01/2026

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention the Psychology GRE Subject test.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 with 19+ in each section.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: 100 (IBT, minimum score of 19 for each section)

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.5 overall (6.5 in listening, reading and speaking; 5.5 in writing).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: 7.5 (minim score of 6.5 each for listening, reading, speaking, and 5.5 for writing)

supervisor.value: You name your top three preferred advisors in the application and are encouraged to contact them first; faculty interest weighs in admission, and an advisor able to fund you improves your chances. Rotations are available but optional.
supervisor.quote: the application asks you to identify your top three faculty that you prefer as your research/thesis advisor | prospective applicants are encouraged to contact potential faculty mentors before applying to discuss research interests and laboratory opportunities | because rotation funding is limited, applicants whose proposed faculty advisor is willing and able to provide funding may have a stronger likelihood of admission

funding.value: Full-time PhD students get a tuition waiver and a monthly stipend through a GTA or GRA (USD 37,500 a year in 2025-26).
funding.quote: Full-time Ph.D. students are supported with a tuition waiver and monthly stipend via Graduate Teaching Assistantships or Graduate Research assistantships. The annual Ph.D. stipend for 2025-2026 is $37,500

entry_route.value: The pages do not say whether a master's is needed; applicants come from psychology, biology, mathematics, engineering and computing undergraduate backgrounds.

notes: Pick the home school of your first-choice advisor (Biological Sciences is the default); the choice does not lock you to that advisor.
